title: Publishing Data Safely
goal: Synchronize thread access to non-atomic data using Release and Acquire orderings.
hints: Stores publish data and require a Release memory ordering.
Loads consume published data and require an Acquire memory ordering.
explanation: `store` operations require `Release` ordering (or `Relaxed` / `SeqCst`). Passing `Acquire` or `AcqRel` to `store` causes a runtime panic. Similarly, `load` operations require `Acquire` ordering (or `Relaxed` / `SeqCst`), and passing `Release` or `AcqRel` causes a runtime panic. `Release` store paired with `Acquire` load establishes a valid synchronization boundary between publishing and consuming threads.
